comment: Tile regions of the raster10 dump for docs/ROM_LAYOUT.md: [char0, 16-word chunk count] in descriptor order — the scene's tiles (values are genroms.py RASTER_SCENES['r10']['tiles']) and the SG pattern block of its sprites (genroms.py pack_patterns: 9 cells at VRAM word 0x2000, cell 0x80). Read by tools/genviewer.py (card #16) and renderer/pce-rom.js; the SAT at VRAM 0x7f00 is NOT a region — it has its own fixed place in bank 1.
